learning_outcomes.text: To gain an ability on application of the thermodynamic laws to engineering practice and solutions of the problems that can be encountered in engineer

syllabus_topics: Content of thermodynamics. Basic concepts and definitions. Temperature, pressure, thermodynamic equilibrium. Work and heat.
First Law of thermodynamics. Application of first law of thermodynamics to open and closed systems
Volumetric properties, ideal gases and ideal gas operations. Real gases and equations of state.
Thermodynamic properties of pure substances. Use of thermodynamic diagrams and tables.
Second law of thermodynamics. Entropy and thermodynamic analysis. (exergy)
